routingTopology.geometryNote: The 173 checked routing edges remain unchanged as topology. Geometry is a separate 2025 MLIT track trace and is never used to calculate travel time.

knownLimits: The render network is clipped to the current metropolitan bbox and four-prefecture polygons; it is not a nationwide map.
N02 records passenger railway infrastructure and station extents, not service frequency, platform access, live operation, fares or route guidance.
River geometry is an OpenStreetMap snapshot. Public redistribution must satisfy ODbL attribution/share-alike requirements even though product UI source buttons are intentionally absent.
Administrative polygons may contain provisional boundaries inherited from the official N03 source.
Only station places have a rail-station crosswalk. Editorial areas and content-object places have no exact point contract, so this draft does not fabricate one.
Waterways are retained only as source-traceable reference data and are explicitly excluded from the v3 map UI.
No bus, road or highway geometry is included. Notable bridge, expressway or road wording must come from explicit prose data, never from this map geometry.
海面以地图底色表达，陆地轮廓由现有N03行政面大幅粗化得到；只供方向识别，不是精细海岸线。
